notes.title: Fist Fight Skills
notes.content:
Check out our new video of the hand and sword fighting mechanics.

The player skills can be enhanced through Nanobots which improve skills, strength, speed and health.

The video and images show locations :
[list]
[*]Truck factory
[*]Houses
[*]Storage facility
[*]Abandoned factory
[*]Town 
[/list]
Stay tuned for more on our Skill, Quest, Inventory and Dialogue systems
